variants.name: Card table
variants.description: Light linen backdrop with ivory, textured role cards in a stacked deck, hold-to-peek pad, list-based clues, votes and heart ledger.

variants.name: Night table
variants.description: Dark felt table where everything is a card: room pass, roles flipped in or out, word pulled from a sleeve, clues as a wallet stack, vote by pulling a card from a fanned hand.
